const fileNameDisplay = container.querySelector('.file-name'); const removeBtn = container.querySelector('.remove-file'); const avatarIcon = container.querySelector('.avatar-icon'); const avatarPreview = container.querySelector('.avatar-preview'); const changeBtn = container.querySelector('.change-btn'); const fileInfoThumb = container.querySelector('.file-info-thumb'); if (!dropZone || !fileInput) return; function preventDefaults(e) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); } ['dragenter', 'dragover', 'dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(function (eventName) { dropZone.addEventListener(eventName, preventDefaults, false); }); ['dragenter', 'dragover'].forEach(function (eventName) { dropZone.addEventListener(eventName, function () { dropZone.classList.add('drag-over'); }, false); }); ['dragleave', 'drop'].forEach(function (eventName) { dropZone.addEventListener(eventName, function () { dropZone.classList.remove('drag-over'); }, false); }); function handleFiles(files, callback) { if (files.length > 0) { const file = files[0]; if (file.type.indexOf('image/') === 0) { callback(file); } else { alert('Please upload an image file (PNG, JPG, GIF).'); } } } function processCoverPhoto(file) { const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = function (e) { if (fileInfoThumb) fileInfoThumb.src = e.target.result; if (fileNameDisplay) fileNameDisplay.textContent = file.name; if (fileInfo) fileInfo.style.display = 'flex'; }; reader.readAsDataURL(file); } function resetCoverUpload() { fileInput.value = ''; if (fileInfo) fileInfo.style.display = 'none'; if (fileNameDisplay) fileNameDisplay.textContent = ''; if (fileInfoThumb) fileInfoThumb.src = ''; } function processAvatarPhoto(file) { const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = function (e) { if (avatarPreview) { avatarPreview.src = e.target.result; avatarPreview.style.display = 'block'; } if (avatarIcon) avatarIcon.style.display = 'none'; }; reader.readAsDataURL(file); } dropZone.addEventListener('drop', function (e) { handleFiles(e.dataTransfer.files, processCoverPhoto); }, false); fileInput.addEventListener('change', function (e) { handleFiles(e.target.files, processCoverPhoto); }); dropZone.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target !== fileInput) fileInput.click();
